history_messages.label: History messages
history_messages.description: How many previous messages of the thread are sent to the model.

user_prompt.label: Custom instructions
user_prompt.description: Your own instructions; they are appended to the profile system prompt and apply to every answer.

agent_base_url.label: Provider URL
agent_base_url.description: Base URL of the model provider for new chats; empty keeps the profile provider.

agent_api_key.label: Provider API key
agent_api_key.description: API key of the model provider for new chats; the saved key is never shown, an empty field keeps it.

agent_model.label: Model
agent_model.description: Model name at the provider for new chats; empty keeps the profile model.

session_mode.label: Permission mode
session_mode.description: How the agent of this chat treats tool permissions.

session_model.label: Session model
session_model.description: Model profile the agent of this chat answers with.
